$Classic Controller
*By Vague Rant and quatric
*Mario Sports Mix (Europe) (RMKP01)
*Play with a Classic Controller: left stick steers, buttons mapped as Wii Remote held sideways.
*Needs a Wii Remote with a Classic Controller attached.
* controller check: accept a Classic Controller (extension 2) where a Nunchuk is expected

$GameCube controller
*By quatric
*Mario Sports Mix (Europe) (RMKP01)
*Play with GameCube controllers: port N drives Wii Remote N (a Wii Remote must still be connected).
* KPADRead, before the empty-ring bail-out: SI poller on; queue a pad sample if the remote sent none
